fact: The IEC, per its Secretary Jefferson Siamisang to the Public Accounts Committee, is rolling out technology-driven reforms to modernise voter registration ahead of the 2029 General Election.

The Ministry of Finance's FY2026/27 Committee of Supply speech appropriates BWP 50,000,000 to the Independent Electoral Commission for installation of electronic voter registration systems, which may straddle two or three financial years.

The IEC Secretary says that after each roll is generated the public can inspect it for 80 days at the commission's secretary's office and designated places, and obtain hard copies for a fee, with no soft copies and no online roll.
